fictionLines.text: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Everett Daly is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
"Everett's gone." Sierra looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Everett." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Ethan blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Everett Daly, 42 days. The mantle passes to Ethan Hunt.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Ethan Hunt, 29 — a trail crew lead.
The village's quarrel was with Everett — and Everett is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
At the grave, Sierra, Matthias, Yara and 1 more speak for Ethan — "Everett trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Ethan before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.

convoLines.text: Some people pray to it. I interrogate it. Different strategy, same silence.
"I asked the sky a question this morning. It didn't answer. I'm keeping a list."
"Ignorance got us here. Knowing gets us out. Or it doesn't, but I'd rather know."

"Right. Sorry, I go on about it. What did you want?"
"You want to know about that? Okay." "Have you heard what they're calling Nightlight? Sierra is pushing 'The Ugly Beast'. Everyone's got a name for it and nobody agrees."
They nod. "Okay."
You show them Wild Ginger — where it grows, how to tell it apart. They nod slowly, committing it to memory. "Good to know. Really good to know."

They go quiet. "Yeah. Me too. The randomness would almost be kinder."

"Walk my trap line with me? Extra hands, extra eyes."
